sources.title: Llama 3.1 | meta-llama/llama-models | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Llama 3.1 is a collection of multilingual large language models available in three sizes: 8B, 70B, and 405B parameters. All variants use an optimized transformer architecture with Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) for improved inference scalability.

sources.title: llama3.1:8b
sources.snippet: Readme Meta Llama 3.1 Llama 3.1 family of models available: 8B 70B 405B Llama 3.1 405B is the first openly available model that rivals the top AI models when it comes to state-of-the-art capabilities in general knowledge, steerability, math, tool use, and multilingual translation.
